summary: 7-year-old boy with 12 h of periumbilical pain moving to the right iliac fossa; paracetamol planned; no weight and no allergy status recorded.

inputs.hpi: 12 hours of central abdominal pain that moved to the right iliac fossa. Off his food. Vomited once.

exam.abdomen: Tender in the right iliac fossa with guarding.

top.note: Every paediatric dose is per kilogram: a missing weight blocks every prescription, so it ranks first (above the missing allergy status).

guideline.name: BNF for Children — prescribing in children (doses by body weight)
guideline.section: General guidance: doses are expressed per kilogram; weigh the child before prescribing
guideline.citation: Paediatric Formulary Committee. BNF for Children. BMJ Group / Pharmaceutical Press.

guideline.name: NICE CG183 — Drug allergy: diagnosis and management
guideline.section: 1.2 Documenting and sharing information: record drug allergy status (including 'none known') before prescribing
guideline.citation: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence. Drug allergy (CG183). 2014.

rationale: Owner's example: a child without a weight — weight first.
